steps.observation: You have 10 seconds. Write a short story about a lighthouse keeper.

steps.action: Old Thom sat each night atop Gull’s Head Lighthouse, scanning the roiling sea for any sign of trouble. One stormy evening, a flash of wreckage glimmered against the waves—a fishing boat’s shattered mast drifting helplessly. With steady hands, Thom lit every lamp in the tower, guiding two frail figures toward the rocky shore. He braved the wind’s howl, lowering a rope swing for the survivors until they stumbled safe onto solid ground. As dawn broke, Thom watched the grateful faces fade into the sleepy harbor town, then climbed back up to polish the lantern glass—ever ready for the next soul in peril.
